predecessor.proof: predは厳密緩和時のみ更新。各保存後d[v]>=d[p]+wを保ち、現存閉路で最後に更新したpred辺がstrictに閉路を閉じた瞬間を使えば閉路和<0。伝播で辺以外の値が下がるlower_bound頂点は開始/途中双方で除外。親は出辺を持つためsources内。検出/visited再初期化をsourcesだけO(E)で行い、sources個の新規成功緩和に課金すれば全体O(VE)。

proof_notes: Nonrecursive Tarjan traverses only vertices reachable from a source with finite/negative distance; it validates each newly referenced adjacency row before using it and records checked rows. Unreachable adjacency is untouched.

Tarjan component pop order is reverse topological; the solve traverses components in reverse pop order. Incoming distances are valid warm-start walk costs, so per-component BF with synthetic source initial values settles finite distances or detects a negative cycle.

A DFS ancestor edge with tree_distance[from]+w<tree_distance[to] is a negative cycle consisting of the ancestor-to-from tree path plus that edge. state bit1 means current DFS frame ancestry, not merely the Tarjan active stack. A witness marks its entire SCC negative.
Each DFS tree path has at most V-1 edges, so int64 tree distances/candidate additions fit under V<=INT_MAX and |w|<=1e9.

A component in which every vertex has exactly one total outgoing edge is a directed ring. Negative rings always have the DFS witness. Other rings settle in two complete directed traversals, including multiple warm-start finite entry distances.

For ordinary SCCs the existing active-frontier style visits a vertex at most once per component pass, capped at component_size-1 passes plus a final relaxation check. Total is O(VE+V+E), scratch O(V); no reverse-edge copy or recursive DFS.

The checked public API owns a local output buffer until success; failed SCC work allocation or validation preserves the old caller output. Dedicated SCC failure-injection tests are being done by the separate review agent.
performance_findings: Unconditional pass16 SCC is rejected: reverse/permuted chains, few reached vertices, and easy component DAGs became3-5x slower.
16V cumulative-frontier budget removes large regressions but adds per-pass overhead (some ordinary cases +2-7%).
Segmenting loops and attempting SCC once at pass16 restores ordinary long-chain cost. Witness variant cuts hard permuted-DAG and negative cases around98-99%, including negative SCC with no self edge.

A sparse strongly connected nonnegative potential graph caused2.2x regression with a wide-frontier-only gate. Requiring growth/nondecrease at the one-time gate prevents that example: 7-repetition retest GCC +2.2%, Clang -0.4%.
Final growth candidate still has GCC random/potential workloads roughly+3-6%, so it is not yet an unconditional adoption recommendation. Parent is comparing pass32/64 gates and code generation.

One growth-matrix run stopped after original46 cases because parent appended zero_ring workloads after the old benchmark binary was compiled. This was an unsupported benchmark mode, not a library failure. Completed rows are preserved.
rejected_or_incomplete: current candidate performance needs parent final compiler/CPU14 comparison

from pathlib import Path
import fcntl,json,random,statistics,subprocess
p=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
cases=json.loads(Path('/tmp/sirkit_bellman_online_20261025/workloads.json').read_text())
cases += [{'name':name,'args':['file','2500','3',str(p/(name+'.in'))]} for name in
          ['negative_no_self','zero_no_self','potential_no_self']]
versions=['baseline','growth']
rows=[]
with open('/tmp/sirkit_performance_cpu18.lock','w') as lock:
 fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX)
 for compiler in ['gcc','clang']:
  for ci,case in enumerate(cases):
   for repeat in range(3):
    names=versions.copy();random.Random(ci*311+repeat).shuffle(names)
    for name in names:
     out=subprocess.check_output(['taskset','-c','18',str(p/(compiler+'-'+name)),*case['args']],text=True,timeout=120).split()
     rows.append({'compiler':compiler,'case':case['name'],'args':case['args'],'repeat':repeat,'name':name,'ms':float(out[0]),'checksum':out[1]})
   group=[x for x in rows if x['compiler']==compiler and x['case']==case['name']]

   med={v:statistics.median(x['ms'] for x in group if x['name']==v) for v in versions}
   print(compiler,case['name'],{k:round(v/med['baseline'],3)for k,v in med.items()},flush=True)

rows=[]

from pathlib import Path
import json,subprocess,fcntl,statistics
p=Path(__file__).resolve().parent

import fcntl, hashlib, json, random, statistics, subprocess, math
root=Path('/home/reinsirk/Atcoder_Env');base=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
original=Path('/tmp/sirkit_bellman_scc_20261025/scc_witness_growth.cpp').read_text()
baseline=(base/'Bellman-Ford.cpp').read_text()
cut=baseline.replace('    if constexpr (UseActive) {\n        if (use_active && !converged && n > 3)', '    if constexpr (UseActive) {\n        // 始点自身を短縮できたなら、到達可能な全頂点が負影響を受ける。\n        if (distance[start_index] < 0) {\n            mark_negative(start_index);\n            converged = true;\n        }\n        if (use_active && !converged && n > 3)',1)
old='    for (std::size_t head = 0; head < queue.size(); ++head)\n        for (const auto &edge : graph[queue[head]])\n            mark_negative(edge.to);\n'
new='    for (std::size_t head = 0; head < queue.size(); ++head) {\n        const int from = queue[head];\n#ifndef SKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS\n        const bool validate = !checked[from];\n#endif\n        for (const auto &edge : graph[from]) {\n#ifndef SKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS\n            if (validate) {\n                if (edge.to < 0 || edge.to >= n)\n                    throw std::out_of_range("BellmanFord: invalid destination vertex");\n                if (edge.w < -max_cost || edge.w > max_cost)\n                    throw std::out_of_range("BellmanFord: cost must be in [-1e9, 1e9]");\n            }\n#endif\n            mark_negative(edge.to);\n        }\n#ifndef SKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS\n        checked[from] = 1;\n#endif\n    }\n'
assert old in cut and cut!=baseline
cut=cut.replace(old,new,1)
variants={'baseline':baseline,'rootcut':cut,'growth16':original}
build=[]
for name,text in variants.items():
 source=base/(name+'.hpp');source.write_text(text)
 exe=base/('screen-'+name)
 cmd=['taskset','-c','6','/usr/bin/g++','-std=c++23','-O2','-DSKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS',
      '-DSIRKIT_TEST_NEGATIVE_PATH_SOURCE="'+str(source)+'"',
      str(root/'Verify/current/tests/bellman_ford_performance_benchmark.cpp'),'-o',str(exe)]
 subprocess.run(cmd,check=True)
 build.append({'name':name,'command':cmd,'source_sha256':hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
work=json.loads((base/'workloads.json').read_text())
# Reduced costs are nonnegative, so these cyclic graphs have no negative cycle.
rng=random.Random(2026102501)
for trial in range(12):
 n=2500;price=50000;phi=[rng.randint(-1000,1000)for _ in range(n)]
 order=list(range(n));rng.shuffle(order)
 edges=[(order[i],order[(i+1)%n],0)for i in range(n)]
 edges +=[(rng.randrange(n),rng.randrange(n),rng.randrange(2 if trial%3 else 10))for _ in range(n)]
 f=base/f'potential-family-{trial:02d}.in'
 f.write_text(f'{n} {len(edges)} {price}\n'+''.join(f'{u+1} {v+1} {price-(w+phi[v]-phi[u])}\n'for u,v,w in edges))
 work.append({'name':f'potential-family-{trial:02d}','args':['file',str(n),'1',str(f)],'repetitions':1})
for name in ['negative_no_self','zero_no_self','potential_no_self']:
 f=Path('/tmp/sirkit_bellman_scc_20261025')/(name+'.in')
 work.append({'name':'file_'+name,'args':['file','2500','1',str(f)],'repetitions':1})
rows=[]
with open('/tmp/sirkit_performance_cpu14.lock','w')as lock:
 fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX)
 for c in work:
  if 'initial_ms' not in c:
   ms=float(subprocess.check_output(['taskset','-c','14',str(base/'screen-baseline'),*c['args']],text=True).split()[0])
   c['repetitions']=max(1,min(1000000,math.ceil(20/max(ms,0.00001))));c['args'][2]=str(c['repetitions']);c['initial_ms']=ms
 for rep in range(3):
  for c in work:
   names=list(variants);random.Random(rep*117+len(c['name'])).shuffle(names)
   checksum=set()
   for name in names:
    out=subprocess.check_output(['taskset','-c','14',str(base/('screen-'+name)),*c['args']],text=True).split()
    rows.append({'rep':rep,'case':c['name'],'name':name,'ms':float(out[0]),'checksum':out[1]});checksum.add(out[1])
   assert len(checksum)==1,(c['name'],checksum)
  (base/'screen-rootcut-results.json').write_text(json.dumps({'build':build,'workloads':work,'rows':rows},indent=2)+'\n')
  print('screen round',rep+1,'PASS',flush=True)
for c in work:
 med={v:statistics.median(r['ms']for r in rows if r['case']==c['name']and r['name']==v)for v in variants}
 ratios={v:round(t/med['baseline'],3)for v,t in med.items()if v!='baseline'}
 if max(ratios.values())>1.04 or min(ratios.values())<0.8:print(c['name'],ratios,flush=True)
print('SCREEN COMPLETE',flush=True)
